Hi Angela — thanks for sending these up-front. Short answers up top, then proposed process.

1) Signer authentication: Yes, Redwood Private/Portal supports SAML SSO + rider assertion so the portal can present a verified signer identity on PO acceptance. We can also maintain a signer-authority table if you prefer portal-managed delegation.

2) PO ack window: Our default is to emit an automated ACK via webhook within ~5 minutes of ingestion. We expose retry/backoff policy and an ops dashboard for failed ACKs (configurable). For Ariba specifically we can map to the 24-hour SLA with a conservative retry cadence.

Proposed process (to keep legal and ops aligned):
- Technical sync (30 min) to confirm SSO metadata and preferred signer-binding approach.
- Legal & procurement to confirm which redline items are gating (liability/cap, data residency, audit logs).
- Ops: we’ll provide the PO-ack webhook spec and an example mapping for Ariba/Coupa PO ID fields.

I can take the technical sync with your SSO engineer and loop in Kimberly for the legal clarifications. Thu 5/15 10:30 PT works on our side.

If that works, I'll send a calendar invite and pull our internal operations doc for the PO-ack mapping so you can review ahead of time.

Thanks,

- PO-ack: our webhook can be configured to ACK immediately with 'received' then emit 'processed' when the PO is validated; we can set retry intervals and a 24h SLA to satisfy Ariba.

Can you send a short summary we can share with MediWell (1 page) and mark which legal redlines are gating for signature?

Irene / Jonas — reviewed the attached redline. High-level guidance below (short so we can share externally):

1) Indemnity / reseller carveout: accept a narrowed reseller carveout limited to third-party claims arising solely from customer's misuse; propose language that disclaims coverage for regulatory fines.

2) Data retention & audit: counter with 3-year retention, provide an operational procedure for export within 30 days of request. We'll include SOC 2 appendix references.

3) Liability cap: do NOT accept exceptions for routine PO/invoice disputes. If they insist on carveouts tied to invoicing errors, propose a specific threshold (>$250k) and require prior written notice and remediation window.

4) PO-ack and signature provenance: not a legal blocker. Recommend we confirm the SSO signer-binding option (SAML assertion) and include a single sentence in the order form that the portal-provided signer identity is the authoritative acceptance evidence, subject to audit logs retained per the data retention agreement.

Attached: quick one-pager summary (orderform_po-ack-flow.pdf) that we can share with MediWell; it maps the webhook lifecycle and shows the SAML assertion fields we will provide.

If all good, I can draft an email to Angela that says: we accept X, we counter Y, and we need a follow-up signature for the order form amendment.
